profile_text.body:
Jasper is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, that builds AI-powered tools aimed at marketing teams. The company describes its product experience as spanning advanced language models, context-aware intelligence, and intuitive agents, with a stated focus on helping marketers customize AI to fit their workflows.

Jasper's tracked products include Jasper for marketing copy, Jasper Campaigns for end-to-end cross-channel campaign creation with a governance dashboard, and Jasper Art for marketing image generation and brand asset creation with commercial use rights. The company's site promotes Image Pipelines as an enterprise-scale feature, claiming it can generate on-brand product imagery at ten times the speed and up to 50 percent lower cost. The site also describes functionality for measuring brand performance across AI answer engines and shipping brand-governed content at scale.

The site's held facts indicate a notable legal exposure footprint in Texas, with 76 associated cases recorded in that state, though no specific litigation details are present in the available data.
